verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both are unusable. The divider line is stretched into a huge blue bar running down the whole canvas. The checkmarks float in empty space, cut off from their labels, which are pushed to the bottom and merged into run-on lines ('Chin Upper lip', 'Chest Bikini Area'). The woman-in-robe photo, the main image, is shrunk to a thumbnail, and the tape pieces and white card are scattered fragments. The $50 price is stuck at the bottom with tape overlapping it, and the MUSELIO.PT text is tiny and misplaced, so there is no hierarchy and the design no longer reads as the original.
